body:
# Unstable Portals
- - -
- This mod will cause Nether portals to collapse if they are further than a specified distance.
  
- The distance can be specified in the config. (default 10000)
  
- The mod is completely server-side.

- - -

![broken portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29afb58fff18c84331c35e1f9fea8698474ad323.png)
- - -
## Available settings in the config:

| setting | description |
| :---: | :---: |
| Overworld limit | The distance after which portals stop working and fail |
| Nether limit scale | Determines the distance limit in the Nether (Overworld limit / Scale) |
| Display message | A message (warning) that will appear above the hotbar |
| Probability of obsidian replacement | The probability of replacing ordinary obsidian with crying obsidian |

- - -
